title: RIPR CLI refusal
description: The standalone document a ripr command writes to stdout when it refuses or fails under a JSON request (--json, or a JSON --format) and has no result document of its own: argv usage errors, context selector misses, and the repair/continue façade refusals. The exit code (2 or 3) and the stderr prose are unchanged. `check` refusals carry the same status/error block inside the check document instead (#11584).

command.description: The first argv word after the program name, or null when argv named no command.

code.description: Closed reason code. Usage: unknown_argument, unknown_value, unknown_command. context: selector_miss. repair/continue: repair_not_started, repair_failed, continue_declined, continue_failed.

message.description: The human diagnostic, verbatim from stderr. Not an authority: branch on code.

next.description: The one command that recovers, or null when no single honest command exists. The key is always present.
